snippet.title: Tales of Eden: Midgard
snippet.description: Midgard is a single-player, unforgiving, action-RPG with a handcrafted open world steeped in Norse mythology. Encounter intense combat and level up your character's skill set to fight your way across the kingdoms of Midgard. Save the people from evil as you trade, craft, hunt and fish to survive!
